annotation.title_clean: Spoken Language Interaction with Virtual Agents and Robots (SLIVAR): Towards Effective and Ethical Interaction
annotation.title_en: Spoken Language Interaction with Virtual Agents and Robots (SLIVAR): Towards Effective and Ethical Interaction
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Devillers, L.; Kawahara, T.; Moore, R.K.; Scheutz, M.
annotation.summary_en: Dagstuhl Seminar 20021 report on spoken language interaction with virtual agents and robots. It covers the seminar program, stimulus talks (including ethical issues), show-and-tell demos and open problems. Ethics is one discussion theme among many; the report contains no formal governance instrument.
key_provisions_or_claims: Aims to bridge the spoken language processing and human-robot interaction communities.
Ethics is a discussion theme: how to create ethical agents and whether robots should pursue goals unknown to users.
Planned outputs include a survey of architectures for embedded ethical competence and a position paper on ethical ML/AI.
Notes there are no clear guidelines for integrating spoken interaction into embodied social agents.
Calls for evaluation protocols for speech-based HRI.
